character: Les Arcs is a group of purpose-built villages (Arc 1600, 1800, 1950 and 2000) above Bourg-Saint-Maurice, linked with Peisey-Vallandry and Villaroger for about 200 km of pistes up to the Aiguille Rouge (3,226 m). The Vanoise Express links it to La Plagne in the Paradiski area (about 425 km), and a funicular connects Bourg-Saint-Maurice station with Arc 1600.
learning: Reference: each Arc village has beginner slopes near the accommodation; confirm beginner-lift access, lessons and which pass tier (Essential, Classic, Premium, Paradiski) a beginner needs.
